'''Avarok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] who was a member of the [[Dread Host]], the servants of the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]], Avarok was stationed in the [[ruptured vault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] with Guardsman [[Varrow]], but after Avarok was defeated in battle by enemies of the Dread Host, Avarok was [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked to death]] by his commander [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tagriss]] all the way from [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />
